units.source_text: 后来伊豫守说起：此次晋京，为的是要办女儿轩端荻的婚事，并且携带妻子同赴任地。

en.t: Later, the Governor of Iyo said that he had come to the capital this time to arrange the marriage of his daughter Nokiba no Ogi, and also to take his wife with him to his post.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听到这话，心中焦虑万状。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, he was overcome with anxiety.

units.source_text: 伊豫守去后，他和小君商量：“我想再和你姐姐会一次面，行不行？”

en.t: After the Governor of Iyo left, Genji consulted Kogimi: “I want to see your sister once more. Is that possible?”

units.source_text: 小君心里想：即使对方是同心的，也不便轻易偷会，

en.t: Kogimi thought to himself that even if the other person felt the same way, it would not be proper to arrange a secret meeting so lightly,

units.source_text: 何况姐姐认为这份姻缘与身份不相称，是件丑事，已经断念。

en.t: especially since his sister considered this attachment unequal to her station, a shameful matter, and had already given it up.

units.source_text: 至于那空蝉呢，觉得源氏公子如果真正和她决绝，

en.t: As for Utsusemi, she felt that if Prince Genji were truly to break with her completely,

units.source_text: 将她忘记，到底是扫兴的，是可悲的。

en.t: and forget her, it would after all be disappointing and sad.

units.source_text: 因此每逢写回信等时，她总是措词婉转，

en.t: Therefore, whenever she wrote a reply and the like, she always chose her words gently and tactfully,

units.source_text: 或者用些风雅词句，或者加些美妙动人的文字，

en.t: sometimes using elegant phrases, sometimes adding beautiful and moving words,
so that Prince Genji found her charming.

units.source_text: 她采取这样的态度，因此源氏公子虽然恨她冷酷无情，

en.t: Because she took this attitude, Prince Genji, though he resented her as cold and heartless,

units.source_text: 至于另一个女子呢，虽然有了丈夫，身份已定，

en.t: As for the other woman, although she now had a husband and her position was settled,

units.source_text: 但看她的态度，还是倾向这边，可以放心。

en.t: judging from her attitude, her heart still leaned toward him, so he could feel at ease.

units.source_text: 所以听到她结婚的消息，也并不十分动心。

en.t: So when he heard the news of her marriage, he was not very deeply moved.
